status: Form-specific references, internal review, content/dictionary/audio and browser checks passed; native review pending.
method: An original fictional news/timetable capstone retrieves already taught forms. Publisher and teacher sources cross-check use and formation; their JLPT tags are editorial, not an official inventory. No source sentences, test items or recordings are imported.

scope.choice: N3 everyday texts, headlines and supported main points guide the reading task. This unit is neither an official sample nor evidence that a learner is exam-ready.

points.form: Reported そうだ and an explicit source
points.formation: Plain verb/i-adjective or noun/na-adjective + だ + そうだ/そうです. Source によると remains attached to the report. Stem appearance そう is distinct.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve unit 3: Monday's decision and Thursday's report do not establish that Saturday's event already occurred.
points.sourceCaution: Bunpro N3 and Sensei N4 tags disagree. Their numerical certainty rankings are not adopted; the task tests source and date, not an invented confidence percentage.

points.form: Causal ため and purpose ために
points.formation: Noun の, na-adjective な, or attributive clause before causal ため; goal contexts support purpose ために. Notice-style causal ため can omit に.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve units 1/9: repairs are the stated venue-change cause. No weather, noise or personal motive is inferred. Tense alone does not determine cause versus purpose.

points.form: Choice ことにした versus arrangement ことになった
points.formation: Dictionary/ない verb + ことにする/なる; past reports the decision or arrangement.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve unit 6 and N4. The framing differs without an absolute personal/external agency rule. Neither past form proves actual attendance. Rule/schedule ことになっている is not silently introduced as identical.

points.form: Negative comparison ほど and the compared quantity
points.formation: AはBほど…ない compares A as less than B on the specified dimension; retrieve AよりBのほうが…. Positive extent/approximation uses are different.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve unit 14. Last year's morning/afternoon visitor counts and the year-before total are comparable; this year's future capacity is not measured attendance.

points.form: A sufficient condition within its stated scope
points.formation: Noun + さえあれば, with the preceding admission/name-check context retained.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve unit 14. A ticket is sufficient after prior acceptance and name confirmation; it is not unlimited unregistered entry.

points.form: Deadline までに versus duration まで
points.formation: Time noun or nonpast verb + までに specifies completion by that point; まで with an ongoing action is duration.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve earlier deadlines with an explicit Friday 17:00 application cutoff. A broad season or day-only deadline is avoided. N4-tagged retrieval, not a newly asserted N3 grammar item.

remaining: Human sentence/listening review; N3 deck expansion and final whole-level gate remain separate.
